plan.failureSummary: The chatbot backend endpoint (/api/chat) returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors, preventing the chatbot from responding to user queries. page.ai correctly detected that messages were left unanswered and returned a status of FAIL, causing the test assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: Network logs show multiple failed HTTP 500 responses for POST requests to https://briefcase.chat/api/chat.
The live UI screenshot and page text analysis confirm user messages were sent but no AI responses were generated or displayed in the chat interface.
page.ai returned { status: 'FAIL', issues: ['The chatbot failed to provide any response to legal-related questions, leaving the messages unanswered.'] }.
Test assertion expect(aiResponse).toEqual({ status: 'PASS', issues: [] }) failed due to the app's failure to respond.

remediationSteps.summary: Resolve HTTP 500 server errors on the /api/chat endpoint
remediationSteps.details: Check server logs and environment configuration for the https://briefcase.chat/api/chat backend service to identify the root cause of the HTTP 500 server errors (e.g. invalid or missing LLM API credentials, exception during stream handling, or service outage).

plan.notes: The test and page.ai agent behaved as expected. The failure is caused by an application backend defect where /api/chat requests fail with 500 errors.
